{# roster-bridge 0.1.0 from @blakesteve/roster 5.17.0 macros.html sha256:7f69b455c50a #} {#- Jinja2 macros for roster-html.css. Usage: {% import "macros.html" as rb %} then {{ rb.status("Paid", "ok") }}. Every macro takes icons_url (default "icons.svg"): the URL your page serves icons.svg at. Status kinds: ok, warn, danger, info. Each one renders its scheme icon next to the text. rb.status with a blank label shows the kind's word (OK, Warning, Error, Info) and an error comment. rb.field renders a label, a control (type "select" takes options, "textarea", "checkbox", or any input type), a hint and an error (icon + text), linked by for, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. -#} {%- set rb_scheme_icons = {"ok": "circle-check", "warn": "triangle-exclamation", "danger": "circle-exclamation", "info": "circle-info"} -%} {%- set rb_status_words = {"ok": "OK", "warn": "Warning", "danger": "Error", "info": "Info"} -%} {%- macro icon(name, label=none, icons_url="icons.svg") -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro btn(label, variant="solid", size=none, href=none, type="button", icon_name=none, disabled=false, icons_url="icons.svg") -%} {%- set cls = "rb-btn" ~ ("" if variant == "solid" else " rb-btn--" ~ variant) ~ (" rb-btn--" ~ size if size else "") -%} {%- if href -%} {% if icon_name %}{{ icon(icon_name, icons_url=icons_url) }}{% endif %}{{ label|e }} {%- else -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro card(title=none, size=none) -%}
{% if title %}

{{ title|e }}

{% endif %}{{ caller() if caller }}
{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro badge(label, kind="neutral", icon_name=none, icons_url="icons.svg") -%} {%- set name = icon_name if icon_name is not none else rb_scheme_icons.get(kind) -%} {% if name %}{{ icon(name, icons_url=icons_url) }}{% endif %}{{ label|e }} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro status(label, kind, icons_url="icons.svg") -%} {%- if kind is not defined or kind not in rb_scheme_icons -%} {%- else -%} {%- if label is not defined or label is none or not (label|string|trim) -%} {%- set label = rb_status_words[kind] -%} {%- endif -%} {{ icon(rb_scheme_icons[kind], icons_url=icons_url) }}{{ label|e }} {%- endif -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- macro alert(kind="danger", title=none, body=none, icons_url="icons.svg") -%} {%- set text = caller() if caller else body -%} {%- if kind not in rb_scheme_icons -%} {%- elif not title and not text -%} {%- else -%}
